promptLine: - Stack: { direction?: "horizontal" | "vertical", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around", className?: string } - Flex container for layouts [accepts children]
promptMentions: - Stack: { direction?: "horizontal" | "vertical", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around", className?: string } - Flex container for layouts [accepts children]

Example: A Stack with on: { "press": { "action": "setState", "params": { "statePath": "/activeTab", "value": "home" } } } sets state, then a container with visible: { "$state": "/activeTab", "eq": "home" } shows only when that tab is active.
